reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is the surplus value function, defined as the difference between on-field performance benefit and rookie contract cost. This is computed per draft pick index, with explicit exclusion of quarterbacks to avoid overvaluation bias. The position exclusion kernel acts as a filter, isolating non-QB picks for valuation. The contract value assumption uses second deals as proxies for first four years' value, acknowledging its limitations. These primitives form a dual framework: one for economic surplus and one for positional filtering. Failure modes include misalignment of contract data with actual performance, or incorrect assumption of second deal representativeness. The model assumes a static cap environment and ignores re-signing value, which may underestimate long-term pick worth.
